verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no user-definable, event-driven rule engine in CoreWeave that triggers actions automatically. Only adjacent features appear: the Kubernetes Cluster Autoscaler scales Node Pools on resource demand, bucket lifecycle policies expire objects, and Grafana alerts cover monitoring. None of these is a general rules-on-events automation capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
